name: medimage-platform
description: Medical Text and Image Processing (AIDS 12605.1) - Adani Institute of Higher Education and Research

scripts.build: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('pip install --break-system-packages --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.txt || pip install --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.txt', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.log('Notice: ' + e.message); }" && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/.next/standalone')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/public', 'frontend/.next/standalone/public', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('frontend/.next/standalone/.next', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/.next/static', 'frontend/.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive:true}); console.log('✅ Standalone static & public assets synced.'); }"
